facts.what: 发现 spare room 只剩两个箱子，水晶、脉轮毯、塔罗全不见
facts.anchor: there’re only two of my boxes left

facts.what: 先怀疑自己梦游，坚信 Finlay 若动过会告诉她
facts.anchor: Because he would have told me if he’d done something with them.

facts.what: 穿上前女友的鞋出门翻垃圾桶，桶全空（bins day）
facts.anchor: I push my feet into another woman’s shoes

facts.what: 扯下衣杆上「她」的全部衣物，觉得布料像毒药
facts.anchor: just the material of someone else’s belongings feels like I’m touching something poisonous

facts.what: 确认不是自己扔的就必是 Finlay，但不明白为什么
facts.anchor: if I didn’t get rid of it, then it had to have been Finlay

facts.what: 浴缸侧板松动，轻敲后像洗衣滑槽打开，内有暗格
facts.anchor: it opens like a laundry chute

facts.what: 从暗格里摸出一本薄书，一眼认出书脊形状
facts.anchor: It is a book. It’s flimsy but I recognise the shape of a spine instantly.

relations: Cassie 发现物品失踪并搜出暗格；与 Finlay 同居
